description: Create a Stripe Checkout URL after a PaidHandshake search when a buyer wants to authorize access to locked results. This tool only creates the checkout handoff and never silently charges the buyer. Use get_unlock_quote first if the buyer only needs pricing, and do not use this for recurring watches or machine-wallet jobs.

package.description: Result package to purchase: single unlocks one selected result, top3 unlocks the next three ranked results, and full unlocks the full available result pack.

result_id.description: Required only when package=single. Use the result identifier from the locked preview returned by search_matches.

search_id.description: Reusable search identifier returned by search_matches for the result set being purchased.

name: create_checkout
